subject: Given possible differences from silent customers, explanation frequencies among voluntary participants and support correspondents do not estimate population prevalence.
rationale: T001 establishes limited voluntary follow-up and support correspondence absent from most customers. Participation and reporting can depend on customer experience, so explanation frequencies in these selected groups lack a warranted basis for population estimation. No sampling or adjustment basis establishing representativeness is supplied. This justifies the stated restriction on population interpretation without establishing that selection bias actually occurred or determining its direction or magnitude.
